notEstablished: This slot exists because the witness stage used to key its output directory by the lane directory name. Every application `acquire` fetches is written to `.versionless/work/<id>/baseline`, so every acquired application shared one `baseline/` slot and each run overwrote the last one's record. The key is now the acquisition identity, which is the name of this directory.

The record in this directory is no longer the migrated bytes. It was regenerated in place by a later run of the same single command against the same pin, under the new key: its `application` field is written by the run rather than restated here, and it reads `react-flame-v2-4-0`. The digests above are that record's; `supersededMigration` keeps the digests of the record that was moved here, so the two are not confused for one another.

`recordCanonicalDigest` is the value the run record's witness row pins for the run that wrote this file. Nothing here re-derives it: a record edited after emission would not be caught by this document.
Nothing here re-runs, re-measures or re-adjudicates the witness run. This file records where a file is filed and what it hashes to, and nothing about what the replay established.
